headline: Wardens Advance in Mooring County as Weathered Expanse Strongholds Fall
war_summary: Since our last dispatch, Warden forces have significantly broadened their footing in Mooring County, pushing their tally to nine strongholds while Colonial positions dropped to two amid fierce engagements yielding over twenty-five hundred casualties in two hours. Across Weathered Expanse, fortifications have crumbled into no-man's-land; four strategic bases now stand demolished, leaving Wardens clinging to three outposts and Colonials to two beneath continuous shelling. On the eastern front, Colonial arms reversed earlier setbacks in Stlican Shelf, reclaiming ground around Briar and Breaker Town to bring their sector count to eight against a solitary Warden stronghold. Coastal fighting in Godcrofts concluded with Colonials securing Argosa, restoring full hex control, even as earlier conflagrations in Pari Peak, Dead Lands, and Palantine Berm cooled to near silence. Further west, heavy casualty tallies persist along the Nevish Line despite immovable lines, rounding out a morning of heavy upheaval along the central and northern frontiers.
